# Psych Vitals

> A comprehensive psychiatry education platform offering exam prep, clinical resources, and teaching materials for medical students and residents across Canada.

Psych Vitals serves Canadian medical trainees with resident-led teaching, question banks, and clinical decision-making content aligned with MCCQE and Royal College exam requirements. The platform provides DSM-5 summaries, rating scales, and curated readings from leading Canadian psychiatric organizations.

## Key Topics

- psychiatry education
- question bank
- MCCQE Part 1
- psychiatry residency
- Royal College exam prep
- DSM-5 diagnostic criteria
- clinical rating scales
- Canadian guidelines
- CANMAT
- mood disorders
- anxiety disorders
- OSCE preparation
- patient handouts
- clerkship program
- clinical resources

## Exam Preparation Programs

- [MCCQE Part 1 Psychiatry Prep](https://psychvitals.ca/mccqe): MCCQE Part 1 psychiatry exam prep with mock questions and clinical decision-making content.
- [Psychiatry Residency Resources](https://psychvitals.ca/psych-residency): Psychiatry residency study resources including Anki flashcards for Royal College exam prep.
- [Clerkship Question Bank](https://psychvitals.ca/clerkship): Clerkship question bank and resident-led teaching for University of Calgary psychiatry students.

## Clinical Reference Materials

- [DSM-5 Quick Summaries](https://psychvitals.ca/quick-summary): DSM-5 diagnostic criteria summaries and clinical guidelines for psychiatry residents.
- [Clinical Rating Scales](https://psychvitals.ca/rating-scales): Clinical rating scales and assessment tools for ADHD, anxiety, and psychiatric evaluation.
- [Recommended Readings](https://psychvitals.ca/readings): Curated psychiatry reading list with Canadian residency guidelines and recommended textbooks.

## Patient Education & Support

- [Patient Handouts](https://psychvitals.ca/handouts): Patient education handouts and mental health resources for healthcare professionals to share.

## Updates & News

- [Tobacco Cessation Guidelines Update](https://psychvitals.ca/2025/12/16/dec-16-2025): Update on tobacco cessation guidelines added to recommended readings list.
- [CANMAT Perinatal Guidelines Update](https://psychvitals.ca/2025/07/13/jul-13-2025): Update on CANMAT perinatal mood and anxiety disorder guidelines added to readings.

- [Psych Vitals Homepage](https://psychvitals.ca): Homepage for Psych Vitals psychiatry education platform with question banks and clinical resources.
